messages.subject: Re: Datatable - Function fnFormatDetails
parts:
Hi Alain,

I guess the key is how to retrieve the DataTable object in JavaScript.
You need the option bRetrieve=TRUE, e.g.

runApp(list(
ui = basicPage(dataTableOutput('foo')),
server = function(input, output) {
output$foo = renderDataTable(
iris,
options = list(bRetrieve=TRUE)
)
}
))

Then you can retrieve the table object using:

oTable = $('#foo').find('table').dataTable()

I'm not entirely sure if this will work out, but it can be one
direction that you can go.

Regards,
Yihui
